41| def normalize_pattern(pattern: str) -> str:
42|     """Normalize one pattern to a workspace-relative POSIX form.
43| 
44|     Rejects absolute paths, drive letters and ``..`` segments.
45|     """
46|     raw = str(pattern or "").strip().replace("\\", "/")
47|     if not raw:
48|         raise ScopeError("write_scope 不能包含空路径。")
49|     if raw.startswith("/") or re.match(r"^[A-Za-z]:", raw):
50|         raise ScopeError(f"write_scope 必须是相对工作区的路径：{pattern}")
51|     segs = [s for s in raw.split("/") if s not in ("", ".")]
52|     if any(s == ".." for s in segs):
53|         raise ScopeError(f"write_scope 不能包含 ..：{pattern}")
